box.highlights: Half Hollow Hills West 45, Westhampton 7: Joseph Filardi rushed for 190 yards on eight carries and two touchdowns and threw for 168 yards on five passes and three touchdowns to lead host Half Hollow Hills West in its Suffolk III opener. Jesse Brooks Had two catches for 101 yards and two touchdowns and an interception on defense. Anthony Raio had three catches for 74 yards and a touchdown and Christian Alfaro rushed for 65 yards on seven carries and a touchdown. Jade Diaz had nine tackles, two for a loss and one sack. Jayden Smith had six tackles, one for a loss and a strip fumble recovery. Nicholas Simone scored for Westhampton.

Half Hollow Hills West 49, Eastport-South Manor 12: Joseph Filardi completed 13 of 16 passes for 270 yards and four touchdowns and added five carries for 121 yards, including an 80-yard TD run to lead visiting Half Hollow Hills West (2-0) in Suffolk III. Jesse Brooks caught four passes for 120 yards and a 75-yard TD and Anthony Raio had three catches for 81 yards and two TDs. Christian Alfaro rushed nine times for 58 yards and a TD. Luke Taff had a 15-yard touchdown reception and Sal Ciazzo returned a fumble 20 yards for a score. Jayden Smith had seven tackles, including three for a loss and Ben Vogt had seven tackles (two for a loss) and a sack. Thomas Powers caught a 52-yard TD pass from Max Ferraro and Joey Hershey added a rushing score for Eastport-South Manor (0-2).

Half Hollow Hills West 47, Hauppauge 17: Joseph Filardi rushed for three touchdowns and threw for another to lead Half Hollow Hills West (3-0) in Suffolk III. Christian Alfaro rushed for two touchdowns and Anthony Raio was on the receiving end of a 74-yard touchdown pass from Filardi. Ryan Levy went 5-for-5 on extra point attempts. Wally Faiz rushed for two touchdowns and Dan Martinez made a field goal and two extra points for Hauppauge (2-1).

Half Hollow Hills West 58, Harborfields 0: Joseph Filardi was 11 for 14 for 281 yards and four touchdowns and added 70 yards and a touchdown on the ground on five carries for Half Hollow Hills West (4-0) in Suffolk III. Anthony Raio caught five passes for 155 yards and two touchdowns. He also had a 60-yard punt return for a TD. Jesse Brooks caught a 44-yard TD pass and added an interception on defense. Mason Reisch had an 8-yard TD reception. Christian Alfaro had a 12-yard rushing TD. Jayden Smith rushed for 88 yards on five carries, including a 22-yard TD. Jerrel Jenkins had six tackles, including a TFL and a sack. Guneal Parhar had six tackles with three TFLs.

Half Hollow Hills West 49, Rocky Point 6: Joseph Filardi completed 6 of 6 passes for 261 yards and four touchdowns, leading Half Hollow Hills West (5-0) to a home win in Suffolk III. Anthony Raio returned a 42-yard punt for a TD and had a 70-yard touchdown reception. Christian Alfaro rushed for 86 yards and two scores on six rushes. Mason Reisch caught two balls for 92 yards, including a 56-yard touchdown. Reisch had four tackles on defense, including three for a loss and a sack. Jesse Brooks had two receptions for 82 yards and two scores. Defensive tackle Sal Santoro had nine tackles. Jayden Smith had seven tackles, with two going for a loss, as well as a forced fumble and recovery. Brogan Casper punched in a 3-yard rushing touchdown for Rocky Point (2-3).
Sayville 28, Half Hollow Hills West 21: Kyle Messina had 28 carries for 200 yards and two TDs and Mikey Sands had 14 tackles, including seven solo and one for a loss for Sayville in Suffolk III.

Half Hollow Hills West 56, Islip 20: Joseph Filardi threw for 323 yards and five touchdown passes on 19 passes and Jesse Brooks caught six passes for 116 yards and three touchdowns to lead visitor Half Hollow Hills West (6-1) in Suffolk III. Anthony Raio caught 7 passes for 126 yards and 2 touchdowns and had an interception and a pass on defense. Christian Alfaro rushed for 2 touchdowns on 6 carries. Jayden Smith ran for one touchdown and Jerrel Jenkins had an interception. Kade Diaz had eight tackles and Mason Reisch had three pass deflections.

Half Hollow Hills West 49, Comsewogue 21: Joseph Filardi completed 18 passes for 484 yards and seven touchdowns, and Jesse Brooks caught five balls for 184 yards and four touchdowns to lead visitor Half Hollow Hills West past Comsewogue in Suffolk III. Anthony Raio caught nine passes for 181 yards and three touchdowns. Luke Taff had an interception. Jayden Smith had 12 tackles. Kade Diaz and Ben Vogt had 10 tackles each for the Colts (7-1). Peter Castaldo ran for two touchdowns for Comsewogue (4-4), and Shane Grant ran in a 16-yard TD.

Half Hollow Hills West 52, East Hampton 6: Joseph Filardi completed 13 passes for 313 yards and four touchdowns, and Anthony Raio caught seven passes for 159 yards and two touchdowns as No. 2 Half Hollow Hills West defeated No. 7 East Hampton/Bridgehampton/Pierson in the qualifying round of the Suffolk Division III playoffs. Raio also had a 58-yard punt return for a TD and a 26-yard interception returned for a score. Jesse Brooks caught three passes for 127 yards and a touchdown. Jayden Smith punched in a 2-yard touchdown on the ground and caught a 16-yard touchdown to open the scoring. Jai Feaster ran in a 3-yard TD for East Hampton/Bridgehampton/Pierson (5-4). Hills West (8-1) advances to the semifinal round to host No. 3 Islip Saturday, Nov. 16 at 1 p.m.
No. 2 Hills West defeated No. 3 Islip, 55-27, in a Suffolk III semifinal.

Sayville 42, Half Hollow Hills West 35
Kyle Messina rushed for 264 yards and four touchdowns on 36 carries as top-seeded Sayville defeated Half Hollow Hills West, 42-35 in the Suffolk Division III final. It is a Suffolk record 16th title for undefeated Sayville (11-0). Patrick Coan completed 11 of 23 passes for 198 yards and a touchdown for the Golden Flashes. Joseph Filardi completed 21 of 35 passes for 370 yards and five touchdowns for Hills West. Anthony Raio had 14 receptions for 283 yards and three touchdowns for Hills West. The finished the season at 9-2.
